outline: This course is designed as an intensive teacher training program for students to become effective EFL teachers. Students are required to do the microteaching and present some selected chapters from the textbooks.
schedule: A detailed syllabus will be distributed on the first day of class.
assessment:
Teaching demo + Lesson plans  30%
Presentation + Final report  30%
Attendance and participation  20%
Midterm exam 20%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

1. Larsen-Freeman, D. (2011). Techniques and principles in language teaching (3rd ed.). New York, NY: Oxford University Press. (Required)

2. Brown, H. D. (2001). Teaching by Principles: An interactive approach to language pedagogue, Second Edition. White Plains, NY: Pearson Education.
3. Brown, H. D. (2000). Principles of Language Learning and Teaching, Fourth Edition. White Plains, NY: Pearson Education.
4. Lightbown, P. M., & Spada, N. (2006). How Language are Learned (Third Edition). Oxford, UK: Oxford University Press.
5. Nunan, D. (2004). Syllabus Design. Oxford, UK: Oxford University Press.
